cells.content:
## Reading this dashboard

- **Portfolio shape:** e2e (68) + web (35) = 84% of all cases; api 6, security 5, performance 3, integration 3, mobile 3.
- **Automation risk gap:** critical is 1/32 automated (3%), high 31/57 (54%), medium 24/34 (71%) — the highest-risk cases are the least automated.
- **Sync:** 55 script mappings, 54 synced, 0 script-updated, 2 case-updated (sync health 96).
- **Staleness:** 50 cases counted stale, 0 updated recently.
- **Data caveat:** get_coverage_stats / get_health_score report 122 cases / 55 automated, one fewer than get_analytics, get_automation_stats and dashboard (123 / 56); 123/56 is used throughout and the 1-case gap looks like a lagging index.
